heading: EXT. NIGHT FERRY - UPPER DECK - NIGHT

units.text: EXT. NIGHT FERRY - UPPER DECK - NIGHT
Wind drags the black water past the rail in long, unbroken sheets.
The ferry's lamps throw a weak yellow circle on the planks, and past that circle there is nothing but weather.
A GIRL, ten, sits on an overturned lifebuoy crate with her knees pulled to her chest.
Her coat is two sizes too big and has belonged to someone else.
Beside her, upright as a post, stands IGNACIO, seventies, a hat clamped in both fists against the gusts.
You said we'd be there by dark.
units.name: GIRL

units.text: It is dark.
units.name: IGNACIO

units.text: You know what I mean.
units.name: GIRL

units.text: He turns the hat in his hands, a slow revolution, as if he could find the right side of it by feel.
The captain says the crossing is slower tonight. Currents.
units.name: IGNACIO

units.text: You always say the captain.
units.name: GIRL

units.text: Because the captain always says.
units.name: IGNACIO

units.text: A swell lifts the ferry and sets it down hard.
The girl's hand shoots out and grips his sleeve.
He does not look at it.
He lets it stay.
What is your name? Your whole name. Tell it to me once more.
units.name: IGNACIO

units.text: You know it.
units.name: GIRL

units.text: I want to hear how you say it.
units.name: IGNACIO

units.text: Her chin lifts against the wind.
Wren Salazar-Imbert.
units.name: GIRL

units.text: Again. Slower.
units.name: IGNACIO

units.text: Wren Salazar-Imbert. Wren. Like the bird. Like the small one that makes the loud noise.
units.name: WREN

units.text: Good. When they ask at the dock, you say it like that.
units.name: IGNACIO

units.text: Who is going to ask?
units.name: WREN

units.text: He does not answer.
The foghorn sounds, once, long enough to shake the rail.
Wren tightens her grip on his sleeve, and neither of them looks toward the dark where the shore should be.
Ignacio. Will you be there?
units.name: WREN

units.text: I am here now.
units.name: IGNACIO

units.text: That is not what I asked.
units.name: WREN

units.text: The ferry rolls.
The lamp swings.
Ignacio sets his hat on her head, pulling it down over her ears, and she lets him.
